major_issues: Mobile: primary canvas/flow area is not well-contained; content feels clipped/tight at the left/right edges and the diagram appears partially cropped rather than intentionally scrollable/zoomable.

Mobile: right-side card stack becomes a very long single column with no in-page navigation/anchors; discoverability of lower sections (Host/eno1/Blocker) is poor and feels like “footer cards” dumped at the bottom.

Text overflow risk: long technical strings (URLs, identifiers, chip labels like “Out shadow-state: blockhash/account truth”) are close to overflowing; current wrapping is inconsistent and can cause awkward line breaks and density spikes.
medium_issues: Hierarchy: top status row (Host / No-Send / blocker / time) is visually similar to secondary text and competes with the page title; needs clearer grouping and reduced noise.
Controls density: zoom controls (Fit, %, +, reset) are cramped on mobile and read like miscellaneous pills; tap targets look borderline and spacing between controls is inconsistent.
Contrast/readability: small gray metadata (e.g., card subtitles, muted labels) is slightly low-contrast on the dark background; in several cards it’s near the threshold for comfortable reading.
Inconsistent card paddings: some cards have generous inner padding while others (notably chips/cta rows) feel tight, leading to uneven rhythm down the right column.
Event strip readability: the ticker-like row at the bottom of the canvas uses small text and tight line-height; it looks truncated and hard to parse quickly.
minor_issues: Chevron on the CAPITAL card looks like an affordance but there’s no clear collapsed/expanded behavior shown; potential misleading interaction cue.
Some labels use all-caps/small caps styles that get noisy on mobile (e.g., section headings) and reduce scan speed.
Spacing between major sections on mobile is slightly inconsistent (some card groups have larger gaps than others).

recommended_changes.change: Make the flow/canvas region explicitly horizontally scrollable on small screens (or constrain with overflow + clear padding). Example: wrap canvas in a container with `overflow:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;` and add `padding-inline: 12-16px` so diagram never hard-touches the viewport edges.

Harden handling of long strings: apply `overflow-wrap:anywhere; word-break:break-word;` on URL/code blocks and chips; for single-line pills/buttons use `max-width:100%`, `white-space:nowrap`, `text-overflow:ellipsis`, `overflow:hidden` where appropriate to prevent multi-line chip explosions.

Improve mobile control bar ergonomics: increase tap targets to at least 40px height, add consistent gaps (8-12px), and allow wrapping into two rows with `flex-wrap:wrap` so Fit/zoom/%/reset don’t compress.

Add lightweight in-page navigation for mobile (anchors/jump links) at the top of the right-column stack: e.g., "Capital", "Runtime", "Ledger", "Handoffs", "Idle". This can be simple `<a href="#ledger">` style links.

Tune typographic hierarchy: reduce prominence of the top status line (smaller, more muted) and increase contrast slightly for small metadata (`--muted` color). Also increase line-height on dense paragraphs and the event strip for readability.

Normalize card spacing: enforce consistent padding (e.g., 16px) and consistent vertical gaps between cards/groups (e.g., 12-16px). Ensure chip rows have enough breathing room and don’t visually collide with borders.
If the CAPITAL chevron is not interactive, remove it; if it is, implement expand/collapse states with visible feedback (rotating chevron, persisted open state) to match the affordance.
Reduce all-caps usage on mobile section labels or increase letter-spacing/size slightly to improve scanability; keep headings compact but clearer.

stop_reason: Not production-worthy yet due to mobile responsiveness issues in the primary flow area (cropping/containment) and weak long-string overflow handling; these can cause clipped content and inconsistent density on real data.
